name: @oneezy/skills-sync
description: One skills library, every agent harness, every project on the machine. Declares third-party sources in skills-sync.json, locks each at an upstream version in skills-sync.lock.json and moves them only on update, links every skill into Claude Code, Codex, Goose and Hermes, and into the projects you pick.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && vp test run
